title: The router arm of the agent benchmark now revalidates stale sources live, so its times are not comparable with earlier rows
goal: agent_bench's router arm calls kb_ask.plan with revalidation off (revalidate=False or KB_NO_REVALIDATE=1) unless a flag asks for it, so its recorded wall times measure the router as before ST-jqwqdj2g made kb_ask.plan revalidate stale sources by default (up to 90 s per question); the repro exits 0 once agent_bench turns it off. SP-etslk6yu review.

run: import sys; s=open('_tools/agent_bench.py', encoding='utf-8').read(); sys.exit(0 if ('revalidate=False' in s or 'KB_NO_REVALIDATE' in s) else 1)

repro_reason: the arm's behaviour shows only in a paid benchmark run; the call's argument is what decides it
